topic: A Knight of God cannot refuse Imu: the Depths Covenant lets Imu override Harald's objection, and Devoted Blades only meet Imu at the knighthood ceremony
title: Why A Knight Of God Can Never Say No To Imu
description: Imu's Knights of God can't actually refuse an order. Chapter 1168 shows the Covenant ceremony and Harald's objection shows what it does. Is a Covenant a promotion or a leash?
comment: Is the Depths Covenant a real promotion that Harald chose, or a leash nobody explained until it was on? Pick one.

lines.text: Imu's Knights of God can't actually refuse an order, and Harald is the proof.

shot.search: Imu Knights of God Harald Covenant
shot.fallback: hooded ruler on an empty throne above a kneeling giant knight

lines.text: Harald served the World Government to win Elbaph a place in the world.

shot.fallback: giant king in dark armor looking over a green land

lines.text: At his knighthood ceremony, Imu placed the Depths Covenant on his body.

shot.fallback: hooded figure placing a glowing mark on a kneeling giant

lines.text: Then Imu ordered him to turn his people into a fighting force. Harald objected.

shot.fallback: worried giant king facing a shadowy ruler

lines.text: A normal boss backs down. Imu used the Covenant to take control of him instead.

shot.fallback: giant king clutching a glowing mark as shadows wrap around him

lines.text: A Covenant isn't a promotion. It lets Imu control, even possess, whoever carries it.

shot.search: Imu possession Covenant abilities Knights of God
shot.fallback: dark shadow reaching into a person's chest

lines.text: Chapter 1149 shows it. Imu takes over Gunko's body to speed up the invasion of Elbaph.

shot.fallback: dark shadowy figure rising out of a woman's body

lines.text: People say Harald chose this. But most Devoted Blades don't learn Imu exists until the ceremony. Chapter 1168.

shot.search: Devoted Blades of God Imu ceremony Empty Throne
shot.fallback: young squire kneeling before a hooded figure on a throne

lines.text: So the leash goes on before they know who holds it.

shot.search: Knights of God Covenant leash Imu Harald
shot.fallback: knight with a glowing chain around his chest

lines.text: So who else would Mary Geoise offer that ceremony to, and who is waiting in a cell for it?

shot.search: Mary Geoise Knights of God offer prisoner
shot.fallback: black uniformed knight standing before a dark prison cell

lines.text: Because once the ceremony is done, Imu's Knights of God can't actually refuse an order...

shot.search: Knights of God Imu orders Knights
shot.fallback: row of kneeling knights before a hooded throne

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim in line 1 that Knights cannot refuse Imu, backed by Harald
self_check.loop: Last line leads back into line 1 syntactically
